name: Historic Monuments of Dengfeng in “The Centre of Heaven and Earth”
description: At the foot of Mount Songshan, China's central sacred mountain, in Henan province, eight clusters of monuments lie scattered across a 40-square-kilometre area near the city of Dengfeng. They were built over nine dynasties and include the Han Que gate towers, the oldest surviving religious structures in China, along with temples, an ancient sundial platform and an observatory. Together they show how people sought the "centre of heaven and earth.
